subject: Redwood pilot — procurement & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood pilot — procurement & onboarding checklist

Hi Alyssa — great call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into procurement: 

Summary from our discovery
- Pilot scope: Redwood hosted inference for feature X (500k tokens/mo), 3 model endpoints, per-route logging for quality monitoring.
- Technical champion: you (Platform) — will own day-to-day integration.
- Target go-live: mid-Oct (aiming for 2025-10-15) if onboarding and PO timelines align.

Stakeholder mapping (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Marcus Lee, CFO (final sign-off on SOW/PO).
- Procurement / AP: Daniel Wu (procurement@cloudscale.com).
- Security / Privacy: Priya Singh (security) — will likely request SOC 2 summary + data handling statement.
- Legal: will route contract redlines to your legal team.

Procurement & onboarding asks (what we need from CloudScale)
1) Confirmation of PO cadence and preferred terms (Net30 vs Net45) and billing contact (billing@cloudscale.com?).
2) Contact details for Daniel Wu (procurement) + Marcus for intro email so we can share the SOW and form packet.
3) Any vendor intake portal link or required vendor forms (Alyssa mentioned a portal).

What Redwood will provide
- Draft SOW and pricing (attached: CloudScale_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf).
- Vendor packet: SOC 2 summary, W-9, commercial terms template (attached as Vendor_Form_Packet.zip).
- Dedicated onboarding checklist and milestone plan (we'll share an internal checklist once procurement route is confirmed).

Proposed next steps
- Could you introduce Daniel and Marcus on this thread by EOD Tue 2025-09-23?
- Procurement sync: propose Tue 2025-09-23 at 10:00 AM PT (happy to move).
- We will prepare a concise security package for Priya and a one-page integration runbook for your platform team.

Attachments: CloudScale_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Vendor_Form_Packet.zip (application/zip)

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@cloudscale.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@cloudscale.com>, Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@cloudscale.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — procurement & onboarding checklist

Thanks for the recap, Ben — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: Marcus Lee (CFO) is the economic buyer and will sign the PO for pilot spend. I've CC'd Marcus and Daniel here so they are aware.
- Procurement contact is Daniel Wu (he handles vendor onboarding and PO issuance). Daniel will likely want the W-9, our standard vendor form, and an online questionnaire we use via our Secure Vendor Portal (link below).
- Security: Priya will expect a SOC 2 Type II summary and an explanation of what data leaves our environment. She prefers short, focused docs — I can share her email after you introduce yourselves.

Portal / intake: https://securevendorportal.cloudscale.com/intake/CS-1102 (Daniel will confirm whether they want us to upload vendor docs there or if they will pull).

PO timing: Daniel said PO cycles vary, but for pilots they typically need 7–14 business days after vendor packet is accepted. Marcus asked that we try to keep pilot spend under their Q4 procurement threshold for expedited approval.

I can do Tue 9/23 at 10:00 AM PT, but if that conflicts we can do 11:30 AM PT. I'll let Daniel confirm.

On the security ask: can you send a short one-page "security + data handling" summary for Priya? That will speed things up.

Thanks — Alyssa
Alyssa Park
Head of Platform | CloudScale Labs
alyssa@cloudscale.com | (206) 555-2211

Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 10:15:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot — procurement & onboarding checklist (CloudScale Labs)

Team — forwarding the thread with CloudScale. Quick internal asks and owners so we can move fast: 

Context: Pilot for CloudScale Labs (RDW-8421). Estimated pilot ARR: $180k annualized if expanded. Target go-live ~2025-10-15.

Owners / requests
- Marissa: can you own procurement onboarding and PO coordination? Key asks: confirm preferred billing email, PO number format, whether they require vendor banking details in a separate secure form, and typical net terms (Net30 vs Net45).
- Vanessa: please prepare a clean SOW + short billing appendix (we should have a DocuSign link ready). Attach the SOW draft and a one-page integration runbook for Alyssa's team.
- Karthik: assemble the security packet — SOC 2 summary, encryption-at-rest/in-transit bullets, data retention/partitioning notes, and an answer sheet for standard vendor questionnaire fields. Alyssa requested a 1-page summary for Priya.

Procurement timeline notes (from Alyssa): PO typically 7–14 business days after packet acceptance. We'll try to compress by pre-uploading forms to their portal.

Attachments for internal: CloudScale_Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (draft)

Can you each reply with ETA by EOD today? I'll schedule the procurement sync for Tue 9/23 10:00 AM PT and update once Daniel confirms.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 08:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot — procurement & onboarding checklist (CloudScale Labs)

Got it — I'll take point on procurement onboarding. Draft timeline and checklist below (assumes CloudScale provides contact info and accepts our packet quickly):

Procurement onboarding checklist (Marissa)
1) Confirm procurement contact and billing email (I'll ask Daniel for both and PO number format).
2) Send vendor packet (W-9, bank info, insurance cert, SOC 2 summary) via their portal or secure upload.
3) Legal review: 3–5 business days after they receive SOW + standard terms (may be longer if redlines).
4) PO issuance: typically 7–10 business days after vendor acceptance / legal sign-off for pilot-sized deals.
5) Invoice submission: send to billing@cloudscale.com with PO number; request invoice terms (Net30 by default).

Notes / risks: If legal requests material redlines on indemnity or data clauses, that can add 7–15 days. Also clarify whether they require any form of SOC 2 attestation or full report (we typically provide a SOC 2 summary and let customers request the full report under an NDA).

Action items I will take today:
- Draft an onboarding checklist and one-page billing instructions for their AP team (attaching onboarding-checklist.md).
- Confirm where to upload vendor documents in the Secure Vendor Portal.
- Ask for the billing contact and whether they prefer invoice PDFs or portal-based invoices.

ETA: I can have the checklist + billing instructions to share with Ben by EOD today.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: onboarding-checklist.md (text/plain)

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Alyssa, and thanks Marissa for owning onboarding. Per the thread: 

1) Scheduling: Tue 2025-09-23 10:00 AM PT works for the procurement sync; Daniel please confirm if you want to keep the portal flow or if we should email the packet.

2) Security summary: attached a short security + data handling one-pager for Priya (Karthik, feel free to replace with your updated version).

3) DocuSign / SOW: sending the DocuSign link for the draft SOW so Marcus can review and sign once legal/PO path is set: https://www.docusign.com/link/REDWOOD-CS-8421

4) Billing info (for AP) — draft we will use unless they request changes: 
   - Invoice to: billing@cloudscale.com
   - Remit to: Redwood Inference, AP Team, PO # (required on invoice)
   - Default payment terms: Net30 (open to Net45 if required)

Attachments: security-data-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)

Next steps for CloudScale
- Daniel: confirm preferred portal vs email for uploading vendor docs and expected PO timing.
- Marcus: if you can confirm budget holder and any internal approval steps that would be helpful.
- Alyssa: introduce Priya on thread or share her email and we'll send the 1-page security summary directly.

Thanks all — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
